svg.title: Flux profile loop — simulated
svg.desc: A simulated view of Flux: device state flows from the binder monitor (with SynthesisCore as fallback) into fluxd, which applies a profile through flux_profiler while HiCo Thermal follows it. The active profile moves from Balance to Performance when a game is in the foreground, to Performance Lite when thermal headroom runs low, and back to Balance when the game exits.
